scope: Numerical width-grid sensitivity using the same refined 8192-sample event curves; no new flux or shape evaluations.
method: Decimate the 321-node uniform log-width grid to its nested 161-node grid. Refit the population on both. Interpolate centered coarse event curves back to fine grid and compare using the existing posterior-weighted metric.
limitation: Checks 161 to 321 only, not 321 to 641; does not establish asymptotic convergence, prior sensitivity or coverage.
